title: Placed Consumer Accounts Risk Table: Portal Bank-Debit Limit by Return Reason
content:
Payments risk table for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It sets the portal bank-debit limit, meaning the amount the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day starts from, according to the reasons for which payments on the account were returned in the last six months.

## Table

| Returns received on the account in the last six months | Portal bank-debit limit |
|---|---|
| One or more payments returned for "account closed" or "stop payment" | $3000.00 |
| None of those, but one or more payments returned for NSF (insufficient funds) | $5000.00 |
| No payment returned for "account closed", "stop payment" or NSF | The stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum |

**Clause.** The portal bank-debit limit is $3000.00 where one or more payments returned for account closed or stop payment were received on the account in the last six months, $5000.00 where no such return but one or more payments returned for NSF were received on the account in the last six months, and the stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum where no payment returned for account closed, stop payment or NSF was received on the account in the last six months.

## Reading the table

- The return reason is the one recorded on the returned-payment entry of the account's money history. Returns recorded for any other reason (an unauthorized debit or a card chargeback) do not move the limit.
- The return's channel is not read; only its reason and its date.
- A return falls in the last six months when fewer than six whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10, a return received on 2026-04-11 is inside and one received on 2026-04-10 is not.
- An "account closed" or "stop payment" return in the period sets the limit at $3000.00 whatever the NSF returns show.

## Hypothetical readings

*Invented histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

| Returns received | Limit |
|---|---|
| NSF on 2026-06-15 and stop payment on 2026-09-02 | $3000.00 |
| NSF on 2026-06-15 only | $5000.00 |
| Stop payment on 2026-04-10 and NSF on 2026-05-01 | $5000.00 (the stop payment is six whole months old) |
| Card chargeback on 2026-08-08 only | The stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum |
| None | The stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum |
